verdict.rationale: Tailscale documents its own SSH feature: Tailscale SSH manages authentication and authorization of SSH connections across a tailnet. Community users confirm SSHing into remote boxes over Tailscale. The evidence never mentions key-based authentication or support for Ed25519, ECDSA, or RSA keys; Tailscale SSH is described as identity-managed, and one user notes a browser-based login flow instead. Missing for 10: any documentation of Ed25519/ECDSA/RSA key support, details of key-based auth in Tailscale SSH, hands-on corroboration of key usage.
